lastbreath.death: %s became a spirit. Soul anchor: %s, %s, %s (%s). Use an offhand Soul Reader to list spirits.
lastbreath.ghost: You are a spirit. Use a Return Totem to revive yourself.
lastbreath.list_header: Online spirits — hold use with a Totem near them to rescue:
lastbreath.no_souls: No fallen players are online. Offline spirits remain dead until they reconnect and are rescued.
lastbreath.not_alive: Only a living player can perform a rescue.
lastbreath.self: Use a Return Totem to revive yourself.
lastbreath.not_ghost: This player is already alive. Nothing was spent.
lastbreath.death_screen: Wait a moment for the fallen player to enter spirit form automatically.
lastbreath.too_far: Approach the spirit in the same dimension.
lastbreath.no_heart: Hold a Return Totem in either hand.
lastbreath.low_health: Not enough health: the cost must leave at least half a heart. Nothing was spent.
lastbreath.unsafe: No safe space nearby. Prepare a dry, solid platform with two clear blocks above it, away from hazards.
lastbreath.blocked: Another rule prevented revival. Nothing was spent.
lastbreath.altar.charges: Altar Totems: %s / 4. Right-click with a Totem to charge.
lastbreath.altar.empty: The altar is empty. A living player must charge it with a Totem.
lastbreath.altar.busy: The altar is already performing a ritual.
lastbreath.altar.started: Ritual started! Stay within 4 blocks for 10 seconds.
lastbreath.altar.cancelled: Ritual interrupted. No Totem was spent.
lastbreath.channel.cancelled: Revival interrupted. No Totem was spent.
lastbreath.tooltip.heart: Hold right-click for 5s near a spirit to revive them.
lastbreath.tooltip.heart_self: Spirits can use a Totem to revive themselves.
lastbreath.tooltip.altar_withdraw: Sneak + right-click with empty hands to retrieve a Totem.
lastbreath.altar.inventory_full: Make room in your inventory. The Totem remains in the altar.
lastbreath.tooltip.executioner_sword: Killing blows harvest souls. Color depends on the creature; chance on configuration and Reaper.
lastbreath.tooltip.mob_soul: Right-click to absorb for skills; bottle for crafting.
lastbreath.tooltip.empty_jar: Right-click to bottle one soul from your inventory.
lastbreath.tooltip.soul_jar: Colored soul for crafting. The empty jar is returned.
lastbreath.jar.no_soul: Pick up a mob soul first.
lastbreath.tree.title: Path of Souls
lastbreath.tree.spirits_only: Only spirits can use the Ritual Table.
lastbreath.tree.hint: Hover to inspect a skill. Click to purchase.
lastbreath.tooltip.reader: Hold Alt: select an ability. RMB: activate. Shift+RMB: soul balance. Offhand Shift+RMB: spirits.
lastbreath.skill.locked: Unlock this ability at the Ritual Table first.
lastbreath.skill.0.desc: +2.5% soul drop chance per rank: 5 → 7.5 → 10 → 12.5%. Costs: 5 / 12 / 25 souls.
lastbreath.skill.1.desc: +2 health after revival per rank. Costs: 5 / 10 / 20 souls.
lastbreath.skill.2.desc: Rescuer health cost reduced by 1 point per rank. Costs: 8 / 16 / 24 souls.
lastbreath.skill.3.desc: Requires Reaper I. Sneak-use the reader while alive: reveal enemies for 8s and slow them for 5s within 12 blocks. Cooldown: 45s.
lastbreath.skill.4.desc: Requires Second Breath I. Sneak-use reader as a spirit: blink up to 8 blocks to safe ground, without crossing walls. Cooldown: 20s.
lastbreath.skill.5.desc: Requires Mercy II. Rescuing a friend grants the rescuer Resistance II for 10s and Regeneration for 5s.
lastbreath.table.hint: Spirit: use table. Living: hold use with a Fierce Soul near the table.
lastbreath.borrow.start: Borrowed Time: %s s. You are vulnerable!
lastbreath.borrow.end: Borrowed Time expired. You are a spirit again.
lastbreath.bond.active: Soul Bond with %s active. You share damage.
lastbreath.bond.none: A nearby living friend with Soul Bond must be available.
lastbreath.bond.request: %s offers to share damage. Activate Soul Bond within 20 s to accept.
lastbreath.tree.requirements: Requires preceding node. Final powers: defeat a boss; Soul Bond also requires rescuing a friend. Check ability configuration.
lastbreath.skill.6.desc: Requires Veil Sight. Creates a temporary decoy that distracts nearby monsters. Available in both forms.
lastbreath.skill.7.desc: Requires Spirit Step. Temporarily restores a vulnerable body. Inventory stays real, with no copies or rollback. Logout ends it.
lastbreath.skill.8.desc: Requires Shared Ward. Two living owners voluntarily share damage. Distance, death or logout ends the bond.
lastbreath.gear.tooltip: Upgrade and recharge at the ritual table.
lastbreath.gear.charge.tip: Spend 1 banked soul for +%s charge. No overflow.
lastbreath.gear.upgrade.tip: Permanent +1 sword damage or +1 cloak armor.
lastbreath.gear.branch.price: Cost: %s red souls. Requires level 1. Permanent choice for this item.
lastbreath.gear.empty: Carry a sword or cloak in your inventory
lastbreath.gear.hint: Uses souls from your personal bank.
lastbreath.gear.branch.1.1.desc: An extra soul roll after a failed ordinary roll. Pays charge only on success. Does not affect bosses.
lastbreath.gear.branch.1.2.desc: Sword kills heal for charge when injured. Has a cooldown.
lastbreath.gear.branch.2.1.desc: Reduces a strong hit for charge. Has a cooldown. Must be worn.
lastbreath.gear.branch.2.2.desc: After surviving a hit at low health, creates a decoy and briefly grants speed. Cannot prevent a fatal blow.
lastbreath.talent.0.desc: Spirit: a decoy distracts monsters for 7 seconds.
lastbreath.talent.1.desc: Both forms: ability cooldowns are 10% shorter.
lastbreath.talent.2.desc: Spirit: highlight the targeted monster for 10 seconds.
lastbreath.talent.4.desc: Both forms: a stronger decoy lasts 12 seconds.
lastbreath.talent.5.desc: Spirit: a short safe dash forward.
lastbreath.talent.8.desc: Both forms: +1 heart; existing vitality bonus is preserved.
lastbreath.talent.9.desc: Spirit: temporary body. Living: Speed II for 8 seconds.
lastbreath.talent.10.desc: Spirit: grant a nearby friend temporary absorption.
lastbreath.talent.11.desc: Both forms: +2 armor; existing ward bonus is preserved.
lastbreath.talent.12.desc: Spirit: Weakness II on the targeted monster for 10 seconds.
lastbreath.talent.14.desc: Living: mutually agreed damage sharing with a friend.
lastbreath.talent.15.desc: Spirit: reveal dropped souls within 32 blocks.
lastbreath.talent.16.desc: Both forms: +2.5% soul chance whenever able to hunt.
lastbreath.talent.17.desc: Spirit: mark a monster for +10% soul chance for 10 seconds.
lastbreath.talent.18.desc: Both forms: equipment charging is 10% more efficient.
lastbreath.talent.19.desc: Living: +15% soul chance for 20 seconds; costs 2 red souls.
lastbreath.wheel.title: Soul abilities
lastbreath.talent.select: Equip an ability at a ritual table
lastbreath.talent.disabled: This ability is disabled in settings
lastbreath.talent.equip: Click to equip / unequip an active ability
lastbreath.talent.locked: Requires a previous node and branch scroll; gold requires an ancient scroll
lastbreath.scroll.tip: Study at a ritual table; duplicates yield fragments
lastbreath.fragment.tip: A broken memory rune. Ancient trial offering: 4 fragments and 1 purple soul.
lastbreath.scroll.missing: No knowledge scrolls in your inventory
lastbreath.shrine.busy: The stone is busy or has shared all its knowledge
lastbreath.shrine.offering: Ancient trial: 4 memory fragments and 1 purple soul, paid on victory.
lastbreath.shrine.peaceful: Trials require a difficulty above Peaceful
lastbreath.shrine.started: Defeat the guardians! Stay within 24 blocks of the stone.
lastbreath.shrine.complete: Memory released. You received a scroll.
lastbreath.shrine.blocked: Not enough safe space around the stone for guardians.
lastbreath.shrine.cancel: Trial interrupted. Your offerings were not consumed.
lastbreath.talent.20.desc: Living: push visible monsters away within 4 blocks.
lastbreath.talent.21.desc: Living: restore 2 hearts for 3 blue souls. Cooldown: 60s.
lastbreath.talent.23.desc: Living: Speed II and Jump Boost for 10s.
lastbreath.talent.26.desc: Both forms: reveal visible monsters within 6 blocks.
lastbreath.talent.27.desc: Living: Resistance II for 6s and Absorption II for 10s. Cooldown: 90s.
lastbreath.feature.disabled: This feature is disabled in server settings
